response.rationale: 'Pending Booking' is not a separate entity. BookingRepository (node 2e3c5728fffb0180, src/persistence/bookingRepository.ts) gets it by filtering its stored bookings: `return [...this.bookings.values()].filter((b) => b.status === "pending");`. So a pending booking is a Booking whose status is "pending". BookingService (node 3aa201f0edaa9fd6, src/business/bookingService.ts) creates those same records with `const booking = this.bookings.create({`, and the graph shows it calling BookingRepository.findPending. Both names refer to the same real-world booking, one of them qualified by status. Confidence is moderate because 'Pending Booking' could also be read as a narrower sub-concept, and the snippets are too short to show the type definitions.
